intro: Kelm Hargunth is the primary supply officer and quartermaster for the Warsong Outriders, stationed at Mor'shan Base Camp on the northern border of the Barrens. He equips Horde champions fighting against the night elves in the contested forests of Warsong Gulch. Through his care packages and provisions, he ensures that the frontline war effort remains fully supplied.

p: Perched on the earthen ramparts overlooking Ashenvale, Kelm Hargunth oversees logistical operations for the Warsong Outriders at Mor'shan Base Camp. While scouts and raiders skirmish beyond the stockade, Hargunth manages the flow of weapons, armor, and rations required to sustain a protracted border war. To him, victory against the Silverwing Sentinels depends as much on steady provisions as it does on raw battle fury.

Hargunth distributes specialized supplies to warriors who have proven their valor in the gulch. From custom care packages stuffed with field dressings and iron rations to mastercrafted armaments bearing the crimson insignia of the Warsong clan, his stores are reserved strictly for those who bleed for the Horde's territorial ambitions in the timber-rich forests to the north.
